Welcome to the Grange

Nestled beneath the Ute Mountains in beautiful Southwest Colorado, Lewis Grange #406 has served local families, ranchers, farmers, and neighbors for generations. Our Grange exists to preserve agricultural traditions, support rural communities, and create fellowship through music, service, dances, meals, and educational programs.

About the Grange

Founded nationally in 1867, the Grange movement began as a way to support farming families, promote education, and strengthen rural America. Today, Lewis Grange #406 continues that mission through local events, volunteerism, and preserving the spirit of Colorado agriculture.
